name: Dynamic Thresholding (mimic scale, cfg_function)
plain: Runs CFG at a high scale but renormalizes values to the range of a lower 'mimic' scale, to get a strong guidance effect without color blow-out. Has schedules for both scales and several normalization choices.
math:
M = u + Δ·s_m, C = u + Δ·s_c (x0 space, s_m,s_c from a schedule)
Flatten; center at per-channel means.
AD: R_m=max|M−μ_M|, R_c=quantile(|C−μ_C|,p); STD: std
ZERO: result = C·R_m/R_c
MEAN AD: Rmax = max(R_m,R_c); r = clamp(C−μ_C,±Rmax)/Rmax·R_m + μ_C
MEAN STD: r = (C−μ_C)/R_c·R_m + μ_C
phi≠1: r ← φ·r + (1−φ)·C
sep_feat_channels: per channel (first option on the full node); channels together on the Simple node.
s_c = s_m: plain CFG.

props.params: mimic_scale, threshold_percentile, mimic_mode, mimic_scale_min, cfg_mode, cfg_scale_min, sched_val, separate_feature_channels, scaling_startpoint, variability_measure, interpolate_phi
